**Skill this week:** exposure assessment, and a capstone map. By the end of the week you should be able to assess exposure with buffers, overlays and community-level measures, explain point and nonpoint pollution, and build a final map that uses the skills from every week.

## Map

Complete ArcGIS Online Exercises 12.2 Air pollution exposure at a local scale, 12.3 Water pollution: sanitation facilities and human health, and 12.5 Global carbon emissions. The links are at [esri.com/Human-Geography](https://www.esri.com/Human-Geography).

For more practice: Exercises 12.1 US air pollution and 12.4 Land pollution: Superfund sites.

## Public health case

As piped water coverage in the ACDIS area rose from 42% to 80% of households, children in the best-served communities had about eight times lower odds of urogenital schistosomiasis than those in the least-served communities.
